objective: ILBI Windows offline desktop with durable ordered two-way synchronization and animated priority queue
requirements: Keep existing user changes and deployment data intact; no production writes while testing.
Bundle the application UI locally so it opens without internet.
Persist authorized tenant data, offline authentication and operations across application restarts.
Support offline sales, cash/debt payments, shifts and stock with transactional local updates.
Automatically reconnect, push ordered operations and pull server updates; detect actual server availability.
Use durable operation IDs and server receipts to prevent duplicate effects after lost acknowledgements.
Preserve dependency order and historical sale prices; surface permission, stock and version conflicts without dropping work.
Scope all local data and sync operations to the enrolled user/device/store; retain server permission validation.
Clickable sync status opens a detailed accessible panel with understandable operation names.
Active operation cannot be interrupted by priority changes; urgent entries move below it with smooth animation.
Urgent operations are FIFO and bring required dependencies forward; ordinary rows retain queue order.
Active row has real upload progress or an indeterminate server confirmation stage; next priority has two rotating arrows.
Waiting rows show Kutilmoqda and Darhol sinxronlash; failed rows explain errors and allow safe retries.
Provide Windows installer/build instructions, update behavior and LAN/multiple-register boundaries.
External Telegram/payment/fiscal actions stay explicit about network/provider requirements.
Test offline/restart/reconnection/lost ACK/priority/dependencies/conflicts/account isolation and full integrated workflows.
Mark each phase complete only after its checks pass; retain evidence and report unverified platform/device limitations honestly.
Delete this temporary tracker only after every required phase is actually complete.
Support independent stores and 1/2/3+ registers per store through a shared LAN primary with pinned TLS pairing and per-actor offline grants.
Retain both existing Classic and Fast workspaces in the Windows application, including offline workspace reminders and a usable sync control in both layouts.
Keep backend, frontend and desktop release version at 1.2.0.

Add a compact public download page linked from the main landing page and both Classic/Fast workspaces; distribute verified versioned installers through a public release manifest, with a future mobile slot.
